/home.change: Preserve the current Home on desktop, phone web and native; keep /today-next a preview.

/dashboard.change: Trace Overdue Tasks and past due to their source, population and time window; label both scopes; open the counted list with matching filters.

/planning.change: With no clustered schools, put the reason and a permitted route to resolve it beside Plan Field Event; with a populated portfolio keep scheduling reachable before summary figures.

/my-plan.change: Keep the spreadsheet; at phone width show the activity label with its planned count; move the swipe cue off header text.

/my-plan/smart-route.change: Show the selected day and school count beside the start action; explain how to add the first school to an empty route.

/schools.change: A readable search field; on phone secondary filters under Filters with removable chips; tell no assigned schools apart from no matches.

/clusters.change: Cluster name, lead and school count in the first row view; creation, group training and meeting scheduling distinguishable.
/clusters.acceptance: Return from a cluster lands on the same filtered list.

/calendar.change: Keep the month controls and Today; keep the selected date when switching activity filters.
/calendar.acceptance: Keyboard and touch open a day; conflicting and empty schedules identifiable.

/core-schools.change: Show whose portfolio or team is selected beside period and totals.

/programme-schools.change: School stage and the next permitted action visible together; Champion, Core Trained and Core Graduate eligibility readable at planning.
/programme-schools.acceptance: Each stage shows its permitted action.

/todos.change: On phone compact the four counts so the first actionable item, its subject and action are in the opening viewport; keep urgency ordering.

/actions/mine.change: Label as assigned school issues; action owner and resolution condition per row; keep the empty state.

/debriefs.change: A clear New Field Debrief entry; weekly reporting secondary for field users.

/cluster-oversight.change: Keep the desktop comparison table; on phone cluster identity and the main exception in the first visible columns.

/core-schools-oversight.change: The two fiscal years and portfolio scope beside comparisons; zero delivery distinct from missing prior-year evidence.

/partner-oversight.change: Partner and period stay visible when switching between assignments and delivery.
/partner-oversight.acceptance: A supervisor moves from an exception to the right partner's records with the same dates.

/projects/monitoring.change: Handoff, planning and delivery distinguishable per enrolled school; stalled entries link to their responsible person or detail.

/fund-requests/weekly.change: Lead with the selected week, request stage, amount and next responsible role; collapse the six-stage explanation and secondary phone filters.

/team-performance.change: Label personal versus team scope and the reporting week beside the figures.

/projects.change: Project name, delivery state and next follow-up visible in the list.
/projects.acceptance: Year and project type kept on return from detail.

/escalations.change: Recipient, blocking decision and latest status shown.
/escalations.acceptance: Sent, awaiting decision and answered checked from sender and recipient.

/extra-work.change: Assignment owner, due date and verification status shown; say where extra work is counted separately in results.
/extra-work.acceptance: Owner, due date and status visible per row.

/budget.change: Period, portfolio, currency and budget basis beside figures.
/budget.acceptance: Monthly and quarterly totals equal their lines under the same scope and currency.

/work-plan.change: Approval state separate from execution state; selected period beside costs.
/work-plan.acceptance: Return from activity detail keeps period and approval context.

/decision-log.change: Each entry leads with decision, actor, date and affected record; audit detail on expansion.

/my-targets.change: Target, achieved and remaining with unit and period together; an explicit state for a missing target.

/my-coaching.change: Feedback needing acknowledgment ahead of history; reviewer and date labelled.
/my-coaching.acceptance: An acknowledged item changes state once.

/loans.change: Lending jurisdiction, currency, stage and next responsible party shown; country configuration reused.

/priorities.change: Agreement state, current owner and next decision at the top.

/my-performance.change: Trace whether showing Priorities is an intentional alias; if so align the menu wording and keep bookmarks, otherwise route to the intended view after confirming it.

/my-professional-development.change: Each request's review stage, required evidence and next action shown.

/personal-time-off.change: Requested dates, leave balance and coverage together.

/schools/closed.change: Closure date and historical status visible.

/more.change: The phone menu renders after navigation from two different pages; Back restores the origin.

/messages.change: Lead with sender, subject and related workflow; unread and assigned states distinct.
